name: git-hex-getRebasePlan
description: Get structured rebase plan for last N commits. Use this BEFORE rebaseWithPlan to preview commits that will be rebased. Returns commit hashes, messages, authors, and dates. Do NOT use if you just want commit history - use git log instead.

repoPath.description: Path to the git repository (optional; defaults to the single configured root if omitted)

count.description: Number of commits to include in plan (default 10, max 200)

onto.description: Base ref to rebase onto (default: upstream if set, otherwise HEAD~count clamped to history; uses empty tree for single-commit repos)

success.description: True if operation succeeded, false if error

plan_id.description: Unique identifier for this rebase plan

onto.description: Base ref the rebase would be onto

commits.description: List of commits in rebase order (oldest first)

summary.description: Human-readable explanation of what was found

suggestions.description: Actionable suggestions for resolving the error
